Sidecar.OfflineHint: Double-click start-wiretap.cmd in the Wiretap module folder. This tab will connect automatically once it's running.

ServerUrl.Name: Sidecar Server URL
ServerUrl.Hint: URL of the Wiretap agent sidecar (default http://127.0.0.1:31416).

TerminalTheme.Name: Terminal Theme
TerminalTheme.Hint: Color theme for the embedded terminal.

FontSize.Name: Terminal Font Size
FontSize.Hint: Font size (px) of the embedded terminal.

AllowMacroExecution.Name: Risk gate: run macros
AllowMacroExecution.Hint: Lets agents run macros. A macro is arbitrary code with GM authority and can call game.settings.set, so enabling this lets an agent change any gate; only enable it for agents you trust.

AllowUserWrites.Name: Risk gate: write users
AllowUserWrites.Hint: Lets agents create, update and delete User documents, roles included.

AllowSettingWrites.Name: Risk gate: write settings
AllowSettingWrites.Hint: Lets agents write Setting documents and world or user settings. Wiretap settings stay unwritable.

AllowFileUpload.Name: Risk gate: file upload
AllowFileUpload.Hint: Lets agents send base64 data in file-path fields and use the file upload tool.

AllowOwnershipWrites.Name: Risk gate: write ownership
AllowOwnershipWrites.Hint: Lets agents change the ownership of documents.

AllowCompendiumWrites.Name: Risk gate: write compendiums
AllowCompendiumWrites.Hint: Lets agents write compendium packs and the documents inside them.

AllowModuleConfigWrites.Name: Risk gate: write module configuration
AllowModuleConfigWrites.Hint: Lets agents write the module configuration, which enables and disables modules.

AllowAgentScripts.Name: Risk gate: agent scripts
AllowAgentScripts.Hint: Lets agents save, disable and run scripts. A script is arbitrary code with GM authority and can call game.settings.set, so enabling this lets an agent change any gate; only enable it for agents you trust.

AllowedPluginModules.Name: Risk gate: plugin modules
AllowedPluginModules.Hint: Comma-separated ids of the modules whose plugin skills and scripts agents may use. A plugin script is arbitrary code with GM authority and can call game.settings.set, so listing a module lets an agent change any gate; list only modules you trust. Empty by default.
